Verify a boundary-limited diff, bin/verify-blocks quick, focused Chromium on tests/e2e/ledger-cards.spec.ts with inspected screenshots, and the full verifier including the five earlier pilots. Exclude schema, copy, visual, or accessibility changes; media, uploads, or a new link policy; shared-utility work; any other block migration; dependency changes; push, pull request, hosted CI, proof publication, merge, and deploy. decisions.question: Lock Ledger Cards as the sixth feature-local pilot, preserving the card a shop owner edits?
decisions.rationale: Ledger Cards is the next mapped block. Moving it adds a repeater plus the existing safe-link policy without a schema, visual, or accessibility change.

alternatives: Move Search Board, preserving its heading and plain-language links.
Move Dispatch, preserving its contact band, phone, and email links.
recommendation.reason: Ledger Cards is verified. Gallery Lanes is the next mapped block still outside src/features/. Search Board and Dispatch are the other bounded moves that do not add a new stored-field policy.
recommendation.recommended: Move Gallery Lanes behind the same feature boundary, preserving its label, meta, link, and image URL.
